key_findings_zh: 该试点表明,即使资源有限,在线社交聆听也可以有效实施。 [10.64898/2026.10.14.26355158]
结果 所提出的 TabNet+GB+RF 自定义软投票在经过调整的基础模型上实现了显着的非随机性能,肯尼亚的 F 1 得分为 0.7111,曲线下面积 (AUC) 为 0.8847。 [10.2196/95727]

papers.title: Predicting Measles Vaccination Defaulting in Uganda and Kenya: Comparative Evaluation of Custom Soft Voting and TabNet Stacked Ensemble Architectures
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Measles is a major cause of death among infants despite free routine immunization (RI) in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Vaccination defaulting contributes to measles outbreak occurrences. Conventional immunization defaulter identification methods are expensive to implement, prone to data falsification, reactive, and overestimate uptake. Several machine learning studies leveraged the use of child and maternal characteristics as predictors of immunization defaulting, overlooking community, demographic, and socioeconomic factors. Similarly, there is limited research regarding the use of interpretable deep learning and advanced ensemble methods to improve model performance in predicting RI defaulters and establishing significant predictors at the national level in the LMIC context, like Uganda. Objective This study predicts infants at a risk of defaulting on measles vaccination in Uganda and Kenya using advanced ensemble learning architectures. Methods The study benchmarked classical and deep learning models using Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) datasets (2016-2022) with child, maternal, community, social-economic, and demographic characteristics as predictors. The robust modeling pipeline began with feature selection according to the literature and the expert domain. It was followed by vaccination eligibility, missing value handling, and feature elimination using the phi-k correlation framework. To mitigate class imbalance, synthetic minority over-sampling technique for nominal continuous features was used in a training pipeline after the RobustScaler. Nine baseline classifiers, including Tabular Network (TabNet), multilayer perceptron (MLP), random forest (RF), gradient boosting (GB), adaptive-boosting (AB), among others, underwent stratified k-fold cross-validation and hyperparameter optimization via grid search. Custom soft voting was evaluated alongside TabNet stack architecture for superior ensemble prediction. Models were evaluated for accuracy, precision, recall, and F 1 -score. Model explainability was decoded using Shapley additive explanations (SHAP), while Streamlit and SQLite formed the tool architecture. Results The proposed TabNet+GB+RF custom soft voting achieved significant, nonrandom performance over tuned base models with an F 1 -score of 0.7111, area under the curve (AUC) of 0.8847 for Kenya. Conversely, for Uganda, the TabNet hybrid ensemble (GB+RF+ AB→TabNet) was the best with AUC of 0.8862 and F 1 -score of 0.6756, which was statistically insignificant. SHAP identified child’s age and vitamin A1 as universal key predictors in both countries; others varied. In Kenya, time to water source, respondents’ education, district lived previously, and current district were the most influential global features, respectively. In Uganda, Polio inactive, Pentavalent3, current district, and respondents’ education were the most influential factors to defaulting, respectively. Conclusions The proposed advanced ensemble learning models improved the classification of measles vaccine defaulters compared to individual models. The study recommends distinct country-tailored strategies. In Kenya, outreaches are recommended to areas with low literacy, distant water sources, and mobile populations. Conversely, in Uganda, the study recommends reminders to avoid missing preceding vaccines and outreaches to high-default districts.

papers.title: Rapid Differentiation of Vaccine and Wild-Type Measles Virus During an Ongoing Outbreak using a new molecular assay
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Differentiating wild and vaccine measles virus (MeV) strains is critical for appropriate healthcare response during outbreak vaccination campaigns. Sequencing, the current standard, is expensive, time-consuming, and limited to specialized laboratories. We developed and implemented a novel differential MeV RT-qPCR assay to address these challenges, which we describe herein. Methods We designed a differential two-step assay; the first step, termed MRRV, distinguishes between rubella, wild MeV, and vaccine MeV. The second, termed “MeV differential”, differentiates between genotypes A (vaccine), B and D. Results The assay detects 10-50 copies per reaction and accurately classifies weak clinical samples (Cq > 32), with 100% accuracy, compared with the N gene sequencing gold standard. Evaluated on over 4,000 clinical samples retrospectively and during the 2025-2026MeV outbreak in Israel, the assay revealed that ∼9% of tested originated from vaccine strain. Among tested municipalities, those running active vaccination campaigns had significantly higher vaccine strain detections (>10 cases each) than those with routine vaccination (1-2 cases). Retrospective analysis of samples from 2018-2024 identified a mix of B and D strains. The novel assay successfully identified double infection cases (exposure to a wild strain shortly before or after vaccination). Conclusion The novel assay proved useful both as a diagnostic tool that enables focused, efficient healthcare response, and as an epidemiological tool that provides valuable information in real-time. This assay is faster, cheaper and more amendable for high throughput testing, compared with the gold-standard sequencing classification.

papers.title_zh: 使用新的分子测定在持续的 疫苗 和野生型 麻疹病毒 过程中快速分化 疫苗 和野生型 麻疹病毒
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Differentiating wild and vaccine measles virus (MeV) strains is critical for appropriate healthcare response during outbreak vaccination campaigns. Sequencing, the current standard, is expensive, time-consuming, and limited to specialized laboratories. We developed and implemented a novel differential MeV RT-qPCR assay to address these challenges, which we describe herein. Methods We designed a differential two-step assay; the first step, termed MRRV, distinguishes between rubella, wild MeV, and vaccine MeV. The second, termed “MeV differential”, differentiates between genotypes A (vaccine), B and D. Results The assay detects 10-50 copies per reaction and accurately classifies weak clinical samples (Cq > 32), with 100% accuracy, compared with the N gene sequencing gold standard. Evaluated on over 4,000 clinical samples retrospectively and during the 2025-2026MeV outbreak in Israel, the assay revealed that ∼9% of tested originated from vaccine strain. Among tested municipalities, those running active vaccination campaigns had significantly higher vaccine strain detections (>10 cases each) than those with routine vaccination (1-2 cases). Retrospective analysis of samples from 2018-2024 identified a mix of B and D strains. The novel assay successfully identified double infection cases (exposure to a wild strain shortly before or after vaccination). Conclusion The novel assay proved useful both as a diagnostic tool that enables focused, efficient healthcare response, and as an epidemiological tool that provides valuable information in real-time. This assay is faster, cheaper and more amendable for high throughput testing, compared with the gold-standard sequencing classification.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 区分野生菌株和 疫苗 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 菌株对于 暴发 疫苗接种 活动期间适当的医疗保健响应至关重要。目前的标准测序昂贵、耗时,并且仅限于专业实验室。我们开发并实施了一种新颖的差异 MeV RT-qPCR 测定来应对这些挑战,我们在此进行了描述。方法我们设计了一种差异两步测定法;第一步称为 MRRV,区分风疹、野生 MeV 和 疫苗 MeV。第二个称为“MeV 差异”,区分基因型 A (疫苗)、B 和 D。结果 与 N 基因测序金标准相比,该检测每次反应可检测 10-50 个拷贝,并对弱临床样本 (Cq > 32) 进行准确分类,准确度为 100%。该检测对以色列 2025-2026MeV 暴发 期间的 4,000 多个临床样本进行回顾性评估,结果显示约 9% 的测试样本源自 疫苗 菌株。在接受测试的城市中,那些开展积极 疫苗接种 活动的城市的 疫苗 菌株检出率(每个 > 10 例)明显高于那些进行常规 疫苗接种 活动的城市(1-2 例)。对 2018-2024 年样本的回顾性分析发现了 B 型和 D 型菌株的混合。新的检测方法成功地识别出双重感染病例(在 疫苗接种 之前或之后不久接触野生菌株)。结论 事实证明,这种新颖的检测方法既可以作为一种诊断工具,能够实现集中、高效的医疗保健响应,又可以作为一种流行病学工具,实时提供有价值的信息。与金标准测序分类相比,这种测定更快、更便宜且更适合高通量测试。

papers.title: Measles Vaccine Uptake During the 2025 Texas Measles Outbreak in a San Antonio Military Medical Center
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To evaluate changes in measles-containing vaccine (MCV) uptake, inclusive of MMR and MMRV, by age group and over time during the 2025 Texas measles outbreak. Methods We conducted a retrospective, single-center, observational study comparing January through August 2024 (pre-outbreak) with the same period in 2025 (outbreak) at a military medical center in San Antonio, TX. The study evaluated MCVs administered and recorded in the electronic health record (EHR) to all patients from 0-18 years enrolled during these periods. The primary outcome was the MCV administration rate (doses per 1,000 child-months). Based on this, we estimated incidence rate ratios (IRR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) comparing 2025 vs 2024 overall and by age groups. Results MCV administration increased from 10.82 per 1,000 child-months in 2024 to 13.22 per 1,000 child-months in 2025, across all age groups (IRR 1.22; 95% CI, 1.11–1.34; p<0.001). This increase was driven by early-dose vaccination in infants aged 6-11 months (IRR 21.09; 95% CI, 9.89–44.98) and children aged 24-47 months (IRR 4.73; 95% CI, 2.84–7.87). MCV administration rates did not clearly differ among children 12-23 months (IRR 1.08; 95% CI, 0.94–1.24), 4-5 years (IRR 1.07; 95% CI, 0.93–1.23), or 6-18 years (IRR 0.54; 95% CI, 0.28–1.06). Peak vaccine uptake occurred early in the outbreak and then declined toward baseline. Conclusions At a military medical center in San Antonio, the 2025 Texas measles outbreak was associated with an early transient increase in MCV uptake principally driven by early infant vaccination, and by late summer, the uptake returned toward baseline.
papers.journal: Journal of the Pediatric Infectious Diseases Society

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Objective To evaluate changes in measles-containing vaccine (MCV) uptake, inclusive of MMR and MMRV, by age group and over time during the 2025 Texas measles outbreak. Methods We conducted a retrospective, single-center, observational study comparing January through August 2024 (pre-outbreak) with the same period in 2025 (outbreak) at a military medical center in San Antonio, TX. The study evaluated MCVs administered and recorded in the electronic health record (EHR) to all patients from 0-18 years enrolled during these periods. The primary outcome was the MCV administration rate (doses per 1,000 child-months). Based on this, we estimated incidence rate ratios (IRR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) comparing 2025 vs 2024 overall and by age groups. Results MCV administration increased from 10.82 per 1,000 child-months in 2024 to 13.22 per 1,000 child-months in 2025, across all age groups (IRR 1.22; 95% CI, 1.11–1.34; p<0.001). This increase was driven by early-dose vaccination in infants aged 6-11 months (IRR 21.09; 95% CI, 9.89–44.98) and children aged 24-47 months (IRR 4.73; 95% CI, 2.84–7.87). MCV administration rates did not clearly differ among children 12-23 months (IRR 1.08; 95% CI, 0.94–1.24), 4-5 years (IRR 1.07; 95% CI, 0.93–1.23), or 6-18 years (IRR 0.54; 95% CI, 0.28–1.06). Peak vaccine uptake occurred early in the outbreak and then declined toward baseline. Conclusions At a military medical center in San Antonio, the 2025 Texas measles outbreak was associated with an early transient increase in MCV uptake principally driven by early infant vaccination, and by late summer, the uptake returned toward baseline.

papers.title: Generating Insights Into (Mis)Information About Measles Vaccination in Amsterdam Through Social Listening, the Netherlands, 2024
papers.abstract: Background: HPV-vaccination prevents HPV-related cancers, but uptake remains suboptimal. In the Netherlands, a catch-up campaign invited 18-27-year-olds for an additional cost-free opportunity to initiate or complete their HPV-vaccination in 2023-2024, which led to 24% of this invited population getting vaccinated. As young adults increasingly seek health information online, understanding online questions, concerns and misinformation in response to the campaign may help improve future vaccination efforts. Supplemental to overall evaluation of the vaccination campaign, we piloted online social listening processes to generate an insight report for Public Health Service (PHS) Amsterdam. Objective This study piloted online social listening processes at the PHS Amsterdam to identify actionable insights into questions, concerns and misinformation surrounding the HPV-vaccination catch-up campaign among young adults. Methods Upon inventory of potential platforms and data sources, a retrospective online social listening analysis was conducted across the platforms Instagram, Facebook, and X, collecting data from PHS, the National Public Health Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM), the Dutch public broadcasting foundation (NOS), and LINDA.meiden sources from January 1, 2023, to June 1, 2024. Publicly available posts, comments, and engagement concerning HPV-vaccination were manually collected, and inductively coded. Themes were assessed for risk, based on expected potential harm and observed reach, and used to develop recommendations. Results A total of 821 posts and 5157 comments were collected and analysed. Ten recurring themes were identified across varying levels of risk. Two themes were classified as high risk: an information gap regarding the effectiveness of HPV-vaccination and concerns about the transparency on HPV-vaccine side effects. Three themes were classified as medium risk: questioning HPV-vaccine effectiveness under certain circumstances, reduced general vaccine trust following COVID-19, and accessibility issues related to vaccination locations and service times. Two themes were classified as neutral risk: questions regarding eligibility criteria for the campaign and calls for broader HIPV-prevention measures. Finally, three low risk themes concerned questions regarding HPV-vaccine brand specifics, campaign choices, and questions about scheduling or rescheduling HPV-appointments. Comments also referred to subsequent information sources, including reliable sources (public health institutes), false narratives and misinformation. Recommendations focused on addressing questions and information gaps (i.e. improving HPV risk perception and providing more detailed HPV-vaccine information), improving communication about HPV-vaccination, and reducing practical barriers to vaccination. Conclusions Manual social listening across selected online sources provided actionable insights into the public discourse during the HPV-vaccination catch-up campaign. Results mostly reflected questions, concerns and information gaps. Although some themes were critical of HPV-vaccination, false narratives and misinformation did not dominate the discourse. Recommendations aim to reduce practical barriers and address information needs. This pilot showed that online social listening can be effectively implemented even with limited resources.

As young adults increasingly seek health information online, understanding online questions, concerns and misinformation in response to the campaign may help improve future vaccination efforts. Supplemental to overall evaluation of the vaccination campaign, we piloted online social listening processes to generate an insight report for Public Health Service (PHS) Amsterdam. Objective This study piloted online social listening processes at the PHS Amsterdam to identify actionable insights into questions, concerns and misinformation surrounding the HPV-vaccination catch-up campaign among young adults. Methods Upon inventory of potential platforms and data sources, a retrospective online social listening analysis was conducted across the platforms Instagram, Facebook, and X, collecting data from PHS, the National Public Health Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM), the Dutch public broadcasting foundation (NOS), and LINDA.meiden sources from January 1, 2023, to June 1, 2024. Publicly available posts, comments, and engagement concerning HPV-vaccination were manually collected, and inductively coded. Themes were assessed for risk, based on expected potential harm and observed reach, and used to develop recommendations. Results A total of 821 posts and 5157 comments were collected and analysed. Ten recurring themes were identified across varying levels of risk. Two themes were classified as high risk: an information gap regarding the effectiveness of HPV-vaccination and concerns about the transparency on HPV-vaccine side effects. Three themes were classified as medium risk: questioning HPV-vaccine effectiveness under certain circumstances, reduced general vaccine trust following COVID-19, and accessibility issues related to vaccination locations and service times. Two themes were classified as neutral risk: questions regarding eligibility criteria for the campaign and calls for broader HIPV-prevention measures. Finally, three low risk themes concerned questions regarding HPV-vaccine brand specifics, campaign choices, and questions about scheduling or rescheduling HPV-appointments. Comments also referred to subsequent information sources, including reliable sources (public health institutes), false narratives and misinformation. Recommendations focused on addressing questions and information gaps (i.e. improving HPV risk perception and providing more detailed HPV-vaccine information), improving communication about HPV-vaccination, and reducing practical barriers to vaccination. Conclusions Manual social listening across selected online sources provided actionable insights into the public discourse during the HPV-vaccination catch-up campaign. Results mostly reflected questions, concerns and information gaps. Although some themes were critical of HPV-vaccination, false narratives and misinformation did not dominate the discourse. Recommendations aim to reduce practical barriers and address information needs. This pilot showed that online social listening can be effectively implemented even with limited resources.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:HPV-疫苗接种 可预防 HPV 相关癌症,但摄取量仍不理想。在荷兰,一项追赶活动邀请 18-27 岁的人在 2023 年至 2024 年期间获得额外的免费机会来启动或完成 HPV-疫苗接种,这导致受邀人群中有 24% 接种了疫苗。随着年轻人越来越多地在网上寻求健康信息,了解针对该活动的在线问题、担忧和错误信息可能有助于改善未来的 疫苗接种 工作。作为对 疫苗接种 活动总体评估的补充,我们试点了在线社交聆听流程,为阿姆斯特丹公共卫生服务 (PHS) 生成洞察报告。目的 本研究在阿姆斯特丹 PHS 试行了在线社交聆听流程,以找出针对年轻人中有关 HPV-疫苗接种 追赶活动的问题、担忧和错误信息的可行见解。方法 在清点潜在平台和数据源后,在 Instagram、Facebook 和 X 平台上进行回顾性在线社交聆听分析,收集 2023 年 1 月 1 日至 2024 年 6 月 1 日期间来自 PHS、国家公共卫生与环境研究所 (RIVM)、荷兰公共广播基金会 (NOS) 和 LINDA.meiden 来源的数据。收集起来,并进行感应编码。根据预期的潜在危害和观察到的影响范围对主题进行风险评估,并用于制定建议。结果 共收集并分析了 821 个帖子和 5157 条评论。在不同的风险级别中确定了十个反复出现的主题。两个主题被列为高风险:有关 HPV-疫苗接种 有效性的信息差距以及对 HPV-疫苗 副作用透明度的担忧。三个主题被归类为中等风险:质疑 HPV-疫苗 在某些情况下的有效性、COVID-19 后总体 疫苗 信任度降低,以及与 疫苗接种 位置和服务时间相关的可访问性问题。两个主题被列为中性风险:有关该活动资格标准的问题以及呼吁采取更广泛的 HIPV 预防措施。最后,三个低风险主题涉及有关 HPV-疫苗 品牌细节、活动选择的问题,以及有关安排或重新安排 HPV 预约的问题。评论还提到了后续的信息来源,包括可靠来源(公共卫生机构)、虚假叙述和错误信息。建议侧重于解决问题和信息差距(即提高 HPV 风险认知并提供更详细的 HPV-疫苗 信息)、改善有关 HPV-疫苗接种 的沟通以及减少 疫苗接种 的实际障碍。结论 通过选定的在线资源进行手动社交倾听,为 HPV-疫苗接种 追赶活动期间的公众话语提供了可行的见解。结果主要反映了问题、担忧和信息差距。尽管一些主题对 HPV-疫苗接种 持批评态度,但虚假叙述和错误信息并未主导讨论。建议旨在减少实际障碍并满足信息需求。该试点表明,即使资源有限,在线社交聆听也可以有效实施。

papers.title: Hemagglutinin and fusion proteins precede measles virus ribonucleoproteins and marshal cell-to-cell spread in airway epithelium
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Measles virus (MeV) is the most contagious human respiratory pathogen. To understand how it spreads in the airways, we infected well-differentiated primary cultures of human airway epithelial cells (HAE). We discovered that the MeV attachment protein (hemagglutinin, H), the fusion (F) protein, and the assembly organizer protein (matrix, M) reach newly infected cells ahead of, and independently from, the replicative complex proteins. To characterize the mechanisms of MeV spread, we generated a replication-deficient adenoviral vector expressing the MeV M, F, and H proteins in a doxycycline-inducible manner. This viral vector formed infectious centers that preserved epithelial function like those from MeV infection. To further dissect this process, we generated Ad vectors expressing individual MeV proteins, termed Ad-M, Ad-F, and Ad-H. Transduction of HAE with single, double, and triple Ad vector combinations revealed that Ad-F and Ad-H are necessary and sufficient to form MeV-like infectious centers. MeV enters and spreads within airway epithelia via H protein binding to adherens junction protein, nectin-4. To disrupt spread, we introduced the point mutation HY543A, a mutation previously described to inhibit nectin-4 binding, in the Ad-H vector. Co-transduction of Ad-F and Ad-HY543A did not result in MeV-like infectious center formation. Finally, we assessed whether the MeV-related paramyxovirus Nipah (NiV) attachment and fusion proteins (G and F, respectively) support cell-to-cell spread. Co-transduction of HAE with Ad-NiV-G and Ad-NiV-F did not result in infectious center formation, suggesting that decoupling of the membrane fusion apparatus function from replication is a unique feature of the MeV envelope glycoproteins. IMPORTANCE Measles virus is a highly contagious pathogen. We characterized a mechanism by which measles virus spreads rapidly through the cells that line the human airway in an ex vivo model. We show that the proteins of the viral membrane fusion apparatus, hemagglutinin (H) and fusion (F), move independently from and reach newly infected cells before the proteins of the replicative complex. Thus, viral protein spread is assembled and arranged in order (i.e., marshaled). Using adenovirus-based vectors, we show that co-expression of H and F proteins promotes rapid sequential spread to multiple cells and the formation of infectious centers. Further elucidation of the mechanism of measles virus amplification and cell-to-cell spread within the lung may help explain its highly contagious nature. Measles virus is a highly contagious pathogen.

papers.title: An evaluation of the performance and usability of a measles IgM rapid diagnostic test within the Uganda national surveillance program using capillary blood and oral fluid samples.
papers.abstract: Abstract Performance of a prototype measles IgM rapid diagnostic test (RDT) was evaluated during suspected measles outbreaks in Uganda. Oral fluid (OF), capillary blood (CAP) and serum samples were collected from participants. OF and CAP were tested using the RDT at patient contact, while usability was assessed through questionnaires administered to health workers, patients, and guardians. Residual OF and IgM-positive RDTs from OF testing underwent measles qRT-PCR at Uganda Virus Research Institute. RDT performance was compared with Siemens anti-measles IgM ELISA performed on sera and with true measles cases, defined as measles ELISA IgM-positive and/or OF RT-PCR positive. Compared to ELISA, RDT sensitivity and specificity were 97.9% (95% CI: 93.7%–99.3%) and 91.7% (95% CI: 84.7%–95.7%) for CAP, and 96.7% (95% CI: 92.2%–98.6%) and 88.0% (95% CI: 80.7%–92.8%) for OF, respectively. Compared with true measles cases, sensitivity and specificity were 90.4% (95% CI: 84.9%–94.1%) and 89.2% (95% CI: 81.5%–94.0%) for CAP, and 88.5% (95% CI: 82.8%–92.5%) and 86.1% (95% CI: 78.1%–91.5%) for OF, respectively. OF and CAP sampling, and RDT use were highly acceptable, and health workers reported the RDT could improve measles management. The RDT demonstrated good accuracy and usability for outbreak settings.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to examine the lessons learned from the West Texas measles outbreak regarding public health leadership and response strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a commentary on the West Texas measles outbreak, which occurred in 2026, and focuses on public health leadership and management practices during the event.
analysis.methods: The methods involved a retrospective analysis of public health leadership strategies and outcomes during the West Texas measles outbreak, including case management, communication protocols, and community engagement.
analysis.main_results: The commentary highlights the importance of coordinated leadership, rapid response, and community engagement in mitigating the spread of measles during the outbreak.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the outbreak as a case study demonstrating the critical role of effective public health leadership in managing infectious disease outbreaks, offering novel insights into leadership practices.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health leadership training and preparedness for future outbreaks, emphasizing the need for proactive and collaborative strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a commentary and does not include quantitative data, which limits the strength of the evidence but provides valuable qualitative insights.

analysis.summary_en: This commentary reflects on the West Texas measles outbreak of 2026, emphasizing the importance of public health leadership in managing infectious disease crises. The study outlines the challenges faced during the outbreak and highlights the need for coordinated, rapid, and community-focused responses. While the analysis is qualitative and lacks quantitative data, it offers novel insights into leadership practices that can inform future outbreak management. The findings suggest that effective leadership is crucial for controlling measles outbreaks and improving public health preparedness. The study's limitations include its reliance on a narrative rather than empirical data, which affects the strength of the evidence but does not diminish its value as a case study.

papers.title: Distinct Humoral Response Development to Measles Virus Across Vaccine Platforms.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Different measles vaccine platforms protect against clinical disease, but characteristics of the resulting humoral responses remain incompletely defined. METHODS: In this study, a phage display immunoprecipitation sequencing technology, VirScan, was employed to evaluate measles viral epitope coverage by antibodies following wild-type (WT) measles virus (MeV) infection of rhesus macaques, or vaccination with a live attenuated MeV vaccine (LAMV), the triple measles-mumps-rubella vaccine (MMR), or a novel recombinant MeV hemagglutinin protein-based vaccine (rMeVH). Vaccinated animals were also challenged with WT MeV to measure antibody epitope reactivity during a recall. RESULTS: The results demonstrate that WT MeV infection elicited a broader epitope reactivity profile than LAMV-containing vaccines. Also, rMeVH vaccination not only resulted in a narrow H protein-specific antibody profile, but epitopes recognized were distinct from LAMV-vaccinated or WT-challenged animals. All vaccine groups expanded the breadth of MeV-specific antibody repertoires following WT MeV challenge. In addition, MeV-specific VarScore, a measure of overall antigen binding, was positively correlated with IgG titer assessed by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, as well as antibody avidity and neutralizing titers. CONCLUSIONS: The results demonstrate the distinct effects of vaccination platforms on the breadth and fine specificity of anti-measles-induced humoral responses, and the utility of VirScan for comprehensively assessing antibody epitope targets.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:不同的 麻疹 疫苗 平台可预防临床疾病,但所产生的体液反应的特征仍未完全确定。方法:在本研究中,采用噬菌体展示免疫沉淀测序技术 VirScan 来评估恒河猴野生型 (WT) 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 感染或 疫苗接种 与减毒活 MeV 疫苗 (LAMV) 感染后抗体对 麻疹 病毒表位的覆盖情况。麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹疫苗 (MMR),或基于新型重组MeV血凝素蛋白的疫苗 (rMeVH)。接种疫苗的动物还接受了 WT MeV 攻击,以在召回期间测量抗体表位反应性。结果:结果表明,与包含 LAMV 的 疫苗 相比,WT MeV 感染引发了更广泛的表位反应谱。此外,rMeVH 疫苗接种 不仅产生了狭窄的 H 蛋白特异性抗体谱,而且识别的表位与 LAMV 疫苗接种或 WT 攻击的动物不同。所有 疫苗 组在 WT MeV 攻击后都扩大了 MeV 特异性抗体库的广度。此外,MeV 特异性 VarScore(总体抗原结合的量度)与通过酶联免疫吸附测定评估的 IgG 滴度以及抗体亲合力和中和滴度呈正相关。结论:结果证明了 麻疹 平台对抗 麻疹 诱导的体液反应的广度和精细特异性的显着影响,以及 VirScan 在全面评估抗体表位靶标方面的实用性。

papers.title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
papers.journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

papers.title: Case Study on Formulating a Multidose Lyophilized Measles-Rubella (MR) Vaccine Candidate for Local Manufacturing in Africa: Lab-Scale Results and Lessons Learned for Future Technology Transfer
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Local manufacturing of Measles-Rubella (MR) vaccines is part of a multifaceted approach to improve vaccine accessibility in Africa, yet process development and technology transfer challenges remain for large-scale production of viral bulks and lyophilized drug product. This case study describes lab-scale formulation development of a multidose, lyophilized MR vaccine candidate, leveraging the availability of concentrated bulks of Measles (MeV) and Rubella (RuV) produced in MRC-5 cells by a new bulk manufacturing process. Methods: Formulation studies utilized both high-throughput RT-qPCR viral infectivity assays and standard lyophilization measurements. The off-patent, publicly available formulation composition of a single-dose, lyophilized trivalent MMR vaccine was evaluated as a starting point to develop a multidose, bivalent lyophilized MR vaccine candidate. To identify optimized conditions, various formulation (e.g., human serum albumin, viral bulk volume), drug product (e.g., vial size, fill volume), and lyophilization (e.g., freezing rate, primary/secondary drying cycle) parameters were evaluated to lower costs and assess MR stability during lyophilization, storage, and reconstitution. Results: Real-time and accelerated stability studies were conducted with four variations of the top candidate MR formulation, filled into primary packaging selected for technology transfer and lyophilized in both lab- and pilot- scale freeze-dryers. An optimized five-dose MR vaccine formulation with 5% (v/v) bulk and 95% (v/v) stabilizer solution, filled at 2X and reconstituted to 1X concentrations, demonstrated promising stability profiles and cost reduction potential. Stability profiles at 2–8 °C were used to estimate the MR release doses needed to ensure the required expiry doses at end of shelf-life. Conclusions: Results are discussed, along with recommendations for future work, in the context of the analytical, formulation, and lyophilization challenges encountered during lab-scale development of a candidate multidose, lyophilized MR vaccine dosage form targeted for technology transfer and large-scale local production in Africa.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹-风疹 (MR) 疫苗 的本地生产是提高 疫苗 在非洲可及性的多方面方法的一部分,但大规模生产病毒原料和冻干药品仍然面临工艺开发和技术转让挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本案例研究描述了多剂量冻干 MR 疫苗 候选药物的实验室规模制剂开发,利用了通过新的散装制造工艺在 MRC-5 细胞中生产的 麻疹 (MeV) 和风疹 (RuV) 浓缩散装的可用性。
elements_zh.methods: 制剂研究利用高通量 RT-qPCR 病毒感染性测定和标准冻干测量。对单剂量冻干三价 MMR 疫苗 的非专利公开制剂组合物进行评估,作为开发多剂量二价冻干 MR 疫苗 候选药物的起点。为了确定最佳条件,对各种配方(例如人血清白蛋白、病毒体积)、药品(例如小瓶尺寸、填充体积)和冻干(例如冷冻速率、初级/二级干燥周期)参数进行了评估,以降低成本并评估冻干、储存和重构期间的 MR 稳定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 对顶级候选 MR 配方的四种变体进行了实时和加速稳定性研究,将其填充到为技术转让而选择的初级包装中,并在实验室和中试规模的冷冻干燥机中冻干。优化的五剂量 MR 疫苗 配方含有 5% (v/v) 散装和 95% (v/v) 稳定剂溶液,以 2X 填充并重构至 1X 浓度,表现出良好的稳定性和降低成本的潜力。2-8°C 的稳定性曲线用于估计确保保质期结束时所需的失效剂量所需的 MR 释放剂量。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 讨论了结果以及对未来工作的建议,讨论了在实验室规模开发候选多剂量冻干 MR 疫苗 剂型过程中遇到的分析、配方和冻干挑战,该剂型旨在用于非洲的技术转让和大规模本地生产。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为多剂量冻干 MR 疫苗 候选药物的配方和稳定性提供了见解,这可以为未来的技术转让工作提供信息,并支持非洲本地制造,以提高 疫苗 的可及性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于实验室规模的结果,不包括大规模生产数据,这可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。由于侧重于实验室规模的开发且缺乏临床试验数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: A Multipatch Model for Evaluating Interdivisional Connectivity and Vaccination Dynamics in the 2026 Bangladesh Measles Outbreak
papers.abstract: The 2026 measles resurgence in Bangladesh motivates a spatial modelling framework that accounts for heterogeneous local transmission, vaccination activity, and interdivisional connectivity. We formulate a multipatch susceptible-vaccinated-infectious-recovered model for the eight administrative divisions of Bangladesh. Division-specific parameters are estimated from reported measles cases \cite{DGHS} and smoothed vaccination data using bounded nonlinear least squares, with uncertainty quantified through 1000 parametric bootstrap replicates. The fitted divisional systems are then connected through compartment-specific movement and cross-patch infection coefficients adjusted for connectivity and the source division's relative reproduction number. The fitted model captures the main division-specific epidemic patterns. Estimated local reproduction numbers range from \(1.1386\) in Khulna (95\% CI:\(0.5703\)--\(1.3834\)) to \(4.3491\) in Dhaka (95\% CI: \(1.4449\)--\(5.6307\)), while Chattogram also exhibits high transmission potential (\(\mathcal{R}_0^i=4.2275\); 95\% CI: \(4.0019\)--\(4.3185\)). Baseline spatial coupling increases the network-wide epidemic peak from \(190.96\) to \(313.20\) infectious individuals and more than doubles cumulative infections from \(1086.42\) to \(2345.35\). Relative to baseline coupling, 50\% and 80\% restrictions reduce the epidemic peak by \(26.69\%\) and \(34.37\%\), and cumulative infections by \(25.07\%\) and \(41.48\%\), respectively. Conversely, a 50\% increase in spatial coupling raises the peak by \(30.14\%\) and cumulative infections by \(23.54\%\). Although local transmission remains dominant in every division, cross-patch infection accounts for \(28.83\%\) of new infections in Rajshahi at the baseline epidemic peak. Source-sink analysis identifies Dhaka as the dominant cross-patch source and Chattogram as a smaller secondary source.

papers.title_zh: 用于评估 2026 年孟加拉国部门间连通性和 疫苗接种 动态的多面体模型 麻疹 暴发
papers.source_body_en: The 2026 measles resurgence in Bangladesh motivates a spatial modelling framework that accounts for heterogeneous local transmission, vaccination activity, and interdivisional connectivity. We formulate a multipatch susceptible-vaccinated-infectious-recovered model for the eight administrative divisions of Bangladesh. Division-specific parameters are estimated from reported measles cases \cite{DGHS} and smoothed vaccination data using bounded nonlinear least squares, with uncertainty quantified through 1000 parametric bootstrap replicates. The fitted divisional systems are then connected through compartment-specific movement and cross-patch infection coefficients adjusted for connectivity and the source division's relative reproduction number. The fitted model captures the main division-specific epidemic patterns. Estimated local reproduction numbers range from \(1.1386\) in Khulna (95\% CI:\(0.5703\)--\(1.3834\)) to \(4.3491\) in Dhaka (95\% CI: \(1.4449\)--\(5.6307\)), while Chattogram also exhibits high transmission potential (\(\mathcal{R}_0^i=4.2275\); 95\% CI: \(4.0019\)--\(4.3185\)). Baseline spatial coupling increases the network-wide epidemic peak from \(190.96\) to \(313.20\) infectious individuals and more than doubles cumulative infections from \(1086.42\) to \(2345.35\). Relative to baseline coupling, 50\% and 80\% restrictions reduce the epidemic peak by \(26.69\%\) and \(34.37\%\), and cumulative infections by \(25.07\%\) and \(41.48\%\), respectively. Conversely, a 50\% increase in spatial coupling raises the peak by \(30.14\%\) and cumulative infections by \(23.54\%\). Although local transmission remains dominant in every division, cross-patch infection accounts for \(28.83\%\) of new infections in Rajshahi at the baseline epidemic peak. Source-sink analysis identifies Dhaka as the dominant cross-patch source and Chattogram as a smaller secondary source.

papers.title: Complications Among Hospitalized Pediatric Patients with Measles at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam, Indonesia, November 2025
papers.abstract: Background: Measles is an infectious disease that remains a major concern in Indonesia. By mid-2025, more than 46 cases of measles outbreak had been reported in the country. Locally, at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam, the number of hospitalized pediatric patients with measles rose from 11 in October 2025 to 28 in November 2025. Outbreak reports globally reported complications of measles including pneumonia and dehydration. These complications can lead to hospitalization. This study aimed to identify the most prevalent complications among pediatric patients with measles at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam, in November 2025 Method: This was a retrospective cross-sectional study on all pediatric patients aged <18 years old with a clinical diagnosis of measles hospitalized at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam, in November 2025. Total sampling was used in this study. Descriptive statistics was performed by Microsoft Excel 2016. Results: A total of 28 pediatric patients with measles were hospitalized. The mean age was 4 years and 9 months. The most prevalent age group was children aged 1 to <7 years old (64.3%). Fever and rash were present in all patients (100.0%), followed by cough (96.4%), and reduced oral intake (60.7%). Laboratory abnormalities observed include leukopenia (42.9%), thrombocytopenia (3.6%) and hyponatremia (21.4%). Fifteen patients (53.6%) had bronchopneumonia and 13 (46.4%) patients had dehydration. Conclusion: Bronchopneumonia and dehydration were the two most prevalent complications among pediatric patients hospitalized with measles at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam.
papers.journal: Indonesian Journal of Innovation Multidisipliner Research

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:麻疹 是一种传染病,在印度尼西亚仍然是一个主要问题。截至 2025 年中期,该国已报告超过 46 例 麻疹 暴发 病例。当地的 Rumah Sakit Hj。巴淡岛 Bunda Halimah,住院的 麻疹 儿科患者人数从 2025 年 10 月的 11 例增加到 2025 年 11 月的 28 例。麻疹 报告了全球报告的 麻疹 并发症,包括肺炎和脱水。这些并发症可能导致住院。本研究旨在确定 Rumah Sakit Hj 的 麻疹 儿科患者中最常见的并发症。巴淡岛 Bunda Halimah,2025 年 11 月 方法:这是一项针对在 Rumah Sakit Hj 住院的所有年龄 <18 岁、临床 麻疹 为 麻疹 的儿科患者的回顾性横断面研究。巴淡岛 Bunda Halimah,2025 年 11 月。本研究使用了总抽样。采用Microsoft Excel 2016进行描述性统计。结果:共有28例麻疹患儿住院。平均年龄为 4 岁零 9 个月。最常见的年龄组是 1 岁至 <7 岁的儿童(64.3%)。所有患者均出现发热和皮疹(100.0%),其次是咳嗽(96.4%)和进食减少(60.7%)。观察到的实验室异常包括白细胞减少症(42.9%)、血小板减少症(3.6%)和低钠血症(21.4%)。15 名患者(53.6%)患有支气管肺炎,13 名患者(46.4%)患有脱水。结论:支气管肺炎和脱水是 Rumah Sakit Hj 住院的 麻疹 儿童患者中最常见的两种并发症。巴淡岛本达哈莉玛。

papers.title: Measles in children: clinical and epidemiological portrait of the infection in modern conditions
papers.abstract: Objective: To study the clinical and epidemiological characteristics of measles in children during a massive increase in incidence. Materials and Methods: A retrospective analysis of 189 medical records of children aged 0 to 17 years hospitalized in the infectious diseases hospital of Krasnoyarsk City Children's Clinical Hospital No. 1 in 2024 with a clinical diagnosis of measles was conducted. Among the patients observed, the most vulnerable group were children aged 1 year (26,5%), followed by schoolchildren aged 7 to 14 (25,9%), 99% of whom were unvaccinated against measles. To date, measles in childhood has retained its classic features; however, the pathognomonic symptom of Belsky-Filatov-Koplik spots was observed in only 67,5% of cases, and photophobia was observed in 14,3%. The overwhelming majority (84,6%) reported a moderate form of the disease, with a complex course, and complications, observed in 66,7% of cases, with a predominance among patients with a complicated premorbid background. The epidemiological situation for measles in Krasnoyarsk Krai in 2024 is characterized as unfavorable. Children under one year of age, unvaccinated due to underage vaccination, and schoolchildren aged 7 to 14 are most often affected, reflecting the accumulation of unvaccinated children in the population and insufficient herd immunity. Therefore, measles vaccination is a necessary, justified, and priority measure for the prevention of this disease.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:研究在麻疹病毒大量增加期间儿童发病率的临床和流行病学特征。材料与方法:对2024年在克拉斯诺亚尔斯克市第一儿童临床医院传染病医院住院的0至17岁儿童的189份医疗记录进行了回顾性分析,这些儿童均具有临床诊断的诊断。观察到的患者中,最易感的群体是1岁儿童(26,5%),其次是7至14岁的学龄儿童(25,9%),其中99%未接种麻疹病毒疫苗。截至目前,儿童期麻疹病毒仍保留其经典特征;然而,贝尔斯基-菲拉托夫-科普利克斑的病原学特征症状仅在67,5%的病例中观察到,畏光症状则在14,3%的病例中出现。绝大多数(84,6%)报告为中度疾病形式,病程复杂,且并发症在66,7%的病例中出现,其中以有复杂病史的患者中更为常见。2024年克拉斯诺亚尔斯克边疆区麻疹病毒的流行病学情况被描述为不利。1岁以下因年龄未满而未接种疫苗的儿童以及7至14岁的学龄儿童最常受到影响,这反映了人群中未接种疫苗儿童的积累以及群体免疫不足。因此,麻疹病毒疫苗接种是预防该疾病所必需、合理且优先的措施。

papers.title: Changing Measles Epidemiology in Ghana, 2018–2023: Exploring Impact of COVID-19-Related Disruptions on Vaccination Coverage and Incidence
papers.abstract: Background: Measles remains a public health threat in Ghana due to persistent immunity gaps and suboptimal vaccination coverage. The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted routine immunization and may have altered measles transmission. This study assessed measles burden, vaccination status of confirmed cases, and spatiotemporal trends in Ghana, and examined the pandemic’s impact on measles control. Methods: We analyzed measles cases reported in Ghana from 2018 to 2023, including age, sex, vaccination status, and region, alongside national measles–rubella (MR) vaccination coverage. Cumulative incidence was calculated as confirmed cases per million population. Interrupted time series analysis assessed pandemic-related disruptions in vaccination coverage and case reporting. Multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with infection and vaccination status. Results: Ghana reported 1688 confirmed measles cases, a cumulative incidence of 51.9 per million, with a case fatality rate of 0.1%. Incidence rose from 1.1 per 1,000,000 in 2018 to 28.3 per 1,000,000 in 2023, with wide geographic variation. The odds of measles infection were higher among those aged 5–14 years (aOR = 1.41; 95% CI: 1.19–1.68, p

analysis.research_question_and_background: Measles remains a public health threat in Ghana due to persistent immunity gaps and suboptimal vaccination coverage. The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted routine immunization and may have altered measles transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study assessed measles burden, vaccination status of confirmed cases, and spatiotemporal trends in Ghana, and examined the pandemic’s impact on measles control.
analysis.methods: We analyzed measles cases reported in Ghana from 2018 to 2023, including age, sex, vaccination status, and region, alongside national measles–rubella (MR) vaccination coverage. Cumulative incidence was calculated as confirmed cases per million population. Interrupted time series analysis assessed pandemic-related disruptions in vaccination coverage and case reporting.
analysis.main_results: Ghana reported 1688 confirmed measles cases, a cumulative incidence of 51.9 per million population, with a case fatality rate of 0.1%. Incidence rose from 1.1 per 1,000,000 in 2018 to 28.3 per 1,000,000 in 2023, with wide geographic variation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the impact of pandemic-related disruptions on measles transmission and vaccination coverage, providing insights into the changing epidemiology of measles in Ghana.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted interventions to improve measles vaccination coverage and surveillance, particularly in regions experiencing increased incidence.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on reported case data and national vaccination coverage, which may be subject to underreporting or incomplete records. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on observational data.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the changing epidemiology of measles in Ghana from 2018 to 2023, focusing on the impact of COVID-19-related disruptions on vaccination coverage and disease incidence. The research highlights a significant rise in measles cases, with a cumulative incidence of 51.9 per million population and a case fatality rate of 0.1%. The study's findings suggest that pandemic-related interruptions have affected measles transmission and vaccination efforts, particularly among children aged 5–14 years. The results emphasize the need for improved surveillance and targeted interventions to address immunity gaps and rising incidence. However, the study's reliance on reported case data and national vaccination coverage limits its evidence strength, which is assessed as moderate due to potential underreporting and observational limitations.

papers.title: COMPARATIVE RATE OF MEASLES AMONG VACCINATED AND UNVACCINATED SYMPTOMATIC CHILDREN: A CLINIC-BASED CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY
papers.abstract: Background Pakistan has been experiencing cases of measles even though there is a very effective and safe vaccine for this disease available for quite some time. The main reason for this is that Pakistan has very low vaccination rates. Objective To compare the rate of confirmed measles infection among vaccinated versus unvaccinated symptomatic children presenting to a pediatric unit, and to assess the magnitude of vaccine-associated protection using relative risk and odds ratio. Methods A clinic-based cross-sectional study was conducted for three months in pediatric departments of Saidu Group of Teaching hospitals,Swat and Northwest General Hospital, Peshawar.. The total number of participants involved in this study were four hundred, aged between 4 months[WA1] [rs2] and 15 years. Participants were categorized into two groups: those who were vaccinated (at least once) or those who were not vaccinated. Information regarding demographics, vaccination status, and measles status of patients was recorded via a questionnaire. Data analysis was performed in SPSS version 25. Results Out of the total 400 children involved in this study, 223 (55.8%) were boys[WA3] [rs4] , while 177 (44.3%) were girls, with a mean age of 4.7 years (± SD 3.8). Out of the total number of 400 children, 201 (50.2%) were diagnosed with the infection of measles. Vaccine coverage was found at 55.5% (n = 222). Maximum prevalence of the disease was seen among 5-10 year-old children (56.6%), Among confirmed measles cases, 58.7% were female and 41.3% were male (p=0.006); sex-specific attack rates were 66.7% in girls (118/177) vs. 37.2% in boys (83/223). There was a significant relationship between measles and vaccination status (p = 0.04), with vaccinated children having a 36% lower risk of measles (RR = 0.64, 95% CI: 0.54–0.75; OR = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.24–0.57). Conclusion It was found that there were a lot of cases of measles in individuals who did not receive vaccination. It can be clearly seen from this study how important it is for the prevention of diseases to get vaccinated.

analysis.methods: Participants were categorized into two groups: those who were vaccinated (at least once) or those who were not vaccinated. Information regarding demographics, vaccination status, and measles status of patients was recorded via a questionnaire.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of vaccination in preventing measles, which can inform public health strategies to improve vaccination rates and reduce measles transmission in Pakistan.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a clinic-based cross-sectional analysis of 400 symptomatic children in Pakistan to compare measles infection rates between vaccinated and unvaccinated groups. It found that 50.2% of children were diagnosed with measles, with a significant association between vaccination status and reduced risk of infection. The results suggest that vaccination plays a crucial role in measles prevention, emphasizing the need to improve immunization rates. However, the study's cross-sectional design limits its ability to establish causality, and the findings are considered moderate in strength due to potential biases and limitations in generalizability.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在斯瓦特的Saidu教学医院群和白沙瓦的西北总医院的儿科部门,进行了为期三个月的基于临床的横断面研究。本研究共纳入400名参与者,年龄在4个月至15岁之间。
elements_zh.methods: 参与者被分为两组:接种过疫苗(至少一次)或未接种疫苗。通过问卷记录了患者的流行病学资料、疫苗接种接种状态和麻疹感染状态。
elements_zh.main_results: 在本研究中,共纳入400名儿童,其中201名(50.2%)被诊断为麻疹感染。在确认的麻疹病例中,58.7%为女性,41.3%为男性(p=0.006);性别特异性发病率为女孩66.7%(118/177)与男孩37.2%(83/223)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as showing a significant relationship between measles and vaccination status (p = 0.04), with vaccinated children having a 36% lower risk of measles (RR = 0.64, 95% CI: 0.54–0.75; OR = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.24–0.57).
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突显了疫苗接种接种在预防麻疹中的重要性,这可以为巴基斯坦的公共卫生策略提供信息,以提高疫苗接种接种率并减少麻疹的发病率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究采用横断面设计,无法确定因果关系,且由于是基于临床的设置,可能存在选择偏倚。因此,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在斯瓦特的Saidu教学医院群和白沙瓦的西北总医院的儿科部门,进行了为期三个月的基于临床的横断面研究。本研究共纳入400名参与者,年龄在4个月至15岁之间。
analysis_zh.methods: 参与者被分为两组:接种过疫苗(至少一次)或未接种疫苗。通过问卷记录了患者的流行病学资料、疫苗接种接种状态和麻疹感染状态。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在本研究中,共纳入400名儿童,其中201名(50.2%)被诊断为麻疹感染。在确认的麻疹病例中,58.7%为女性,41.3%为男性(p=0.006);性别特异性发病率为女孩66.7%(118/177)与男孩37.2%(83/223)。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突显了疫苗接种接种在预防麻疹中的重要性,这可以为巴基斯坦的公共卫生策略提供信息,以提高疫苗接种接种率并减少麻疹的发病率。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究采用横断面设计,无法确定因果关系,且由于是基于临床的设置,可能存在选择偏倚。因此,证据强度中等。

papers.full_text: Disclaimer: Early release articles are not considered as final versions. Any changes will be reflected in the online version in the month the article is officially released. Volume 32, Number 11—November 2026 Synopsis Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis after Measles Outbreaks, the Philippines, 2007–2022 Suggested citation for this article Abstract Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a delayed, almost uniformly fatal complication of measles. The Philippines had measles outbreaks in 2010–2011, 2013, and 2018–2019; the last was the largest in the World Health Organization Western Pacific Region. Published SSPE data from the Philippines end in 2015. We reviewed all 20 children admitted with SSPE to a tertiary pediatric hospital in Quezon City during 2007–2022 and estimated year of measles infection. Median patient age was 6.2 years at hospital admission and 0.7 years at reported measles illness. Five (25.0%) of 20 admissions occurred in 2022, and estimated infection dates placed 4 patients within the 2018–2019 outbreak; all were admitted during 2020–2022. Given the multiyear latency of SSPE, additional cases might emerge over coming years. Reported measles history could not be established in one quarter of patients. Strengthened measles surveillance and sustained 2-dose vaccination coverage are needed. Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder caused by persistent central nervous system infection with a defective, hypermutant measles virus. It typically follows measles acquired in early childhood after a latency of years and is almost always fatal (1,2). Because SSPE follows measles by years rather than weeks, the neurologic consequences of an outbreak do not become visible until long after the outbreak has ended. Measles vaccination was introduced in the Philippines in 1983; the first routine dose is scheduled at 9 months of age (3). Nationwide immunization campaigns in 1998 and 2004 were followed by historically low measles incidence in 2006 (3). First-dose measles-containing vaccine coverage later declined from 92% in 2004–2007 to 80% in 2015–2016 and 64% in 2021 (4). Reported measles cases rose sharply during a 2018–2019 outbreak, from 2,428 in 2017 to 48,525 in 2019, the largest outbreak in the World Health Organization Western Pacific Region during that period (5). Published data on SSPE in the Philippines are limited; the largest local series described children seen at a single tertiary hospital during 2005–2015 (6). No published series from the Philippines spans the period during which children infected in the 2018–2019 outbreak would be expected to demonstrate symptoms of SSPE. We describe children admitted with SSPE to a tertiary government pediatric hospital over 16 years and examine the distribution of their estimated years of measles infection against the national outbreak record. Design and Setting We retrospectively reviewed the records of all children admitted to National Children’s Hospital, a tertiary government pediatric hospital in Quezon City, the Philippines, with a final diagnosis of SSPE during January 1, 2007–December 31, 2022. All such patients were enumerated. The 2007 start date reflects the period from which complete institutional records and corresponding registry data were available. Case Definition We modified the case definition from Dyken’s criteria (1). We defined a case as a clinical diagnosis of SSPE by the attending pediatric neurologist on the basis of progressive neurologic deterioration with qualitatively positive measles antibody in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), serum, or both. We excluded children with bacterial, tuberculous, or viral meningitis and children with intracranial masses. Because quantitative measles antibody titers, CSF globulin fractionation, brain biopsy, and uniform electroencephalography were unavailable, we could not apply the full Dyken criteria; we classified cases as clinically diagnosed SSPE with varying levels of supportive evidence. Variables Age at reported measles infection and reported measles history came from parental or guardian recall recorded at admission; measles history was recorded as reported, absent, or unknown. Vaccination status was likewise based on parent or guardian report recorded at admission and was not consistently verified against immunization records. Estimation of Year of Reported Measles Infection For each patient, we calculated the interval between measles infection and development of SSPE as age at hospital admission minus age at measles infection. We obtained the estimated calendar year of measles infection by subtracting that interval from the year of admission. We then compared estimated infection years with the recorded periods of national measles outbreak activity. For the 14 children with a parent- or guardian-reported history of measles, we calculated the interval between reported measles illness and hospital admission. We excluded 3 children with a reported measles-to-admission interval of <1 year from the interval analysis, because such a short interval is atypical for SSPE and the timing of the reported measles illness could not be independently verified. A very short interval can also reflect acute measles encephalitis (within 14 days of rash onset) or acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (within weeks), rather than SSPE, which follows a latency of years (1). Statistical Analysis We summarized categorical variables as frequencies and percentages and summarized continuous variables as medians with interquartile ranges. We did not group patients by admission year for comparison, because the multiyear interval between infection and admission makes such grouping uninterpretable. Analyses used Stata 16.1 (StataCorps LLC, https://www.stata.com) and Microsoft Excel (https://www.microsoft.com). The protocol was approved by the National Children’s Hospital Institutional Review Board (approval no. NCH-IRB 2023–12-NCT) using unlinked, deidentified data. Twenty children admitted during January 1, 2007–December 31, 2022, met the case definition. Cases were unevenly distributed across the study period (Figure, panel A). Eight (40.0%) of the 20 admissions occurred in the final 3 years of the series, and 5 (25.0%) admissions occurred in 2022 alone. Four patients had an estimated measles infection year of 2018 or 2019, corresponding to the national outbreak period (Figure, panel B); all 4 had a reported measles history and positive CSF antibody, and all were admitted during 2020–2022 with intervals of 2.1–3.5 years since measles infection. For 3 patients, the estimated infection year was 2004; estimated infection year for 1 patient was 2013. Most patients with an estimable year (14 of 19) were infected outside recognized outbreak periods, consistent with continued transmission between outbreaks. SSPE was suspected at time of admission in 9 (45.0%) patients. The remainder were admitted under other working diagnoses: probable intracranial mass in 4 (20.0%) patients, meningitis in 3 (15.0%) patients, encephalitis in 2 (10.0%) patients, and 1 (5.0%) each of acute rheumatic fever and traumatic brain injury. At discharge, 18 (90.0%) patients carried a diagnosis of SSPE and 2 (10.0%) patients probable SSPE. Of the 20 patients, 14 (70.0%) patients were male and 6 (30.0%) were female. The median age was 6.2 years at admission and 0.7 years at reported measles illness; 10 of the 19 patients with an estimable age were infected before the age of 9 months. Eight children had stunting or wasting, and 3 had comorbidities. A reported measles history was present in 15 (75.0%), unknown in 4 (20.0%), and absent in 1 (5.0%). Seventeen (85.0%) patients had received >1 measles-containing vaccine; 11 (55.0%) patients had received a single dose only. Twelve (60.0%) patients were admitted in stage 2 and 5 (25.0%) were admitted in stage 3 (Table; Appendix Table). Among the 14 children with a reported measles history, the median interval from measles to hospital admission was 5.8 (interquartile range 3.5–8.9) years. Among the 20 children, 5 had progressive neurologic deterioration, tested positive for measles antibody in CSF, and had characteristic electroencephalography; 12 had progressive deterioration and antibody-positive CSF without electroencephalography; and 3 had progressive deterioration with antibody-positive serum only. Measles antibody testing of CSF was performed in 17 patients and was positive in all 17; serum antibody was tested in 13 and positive in all 13. Both were tested in 10 patients; 3 patients had serum testing alone. Electroencephalography was performed in 5 patients (25.0%); all showed patterns consistent with SSPE (7). In this 16-year series, cases of SSPE clustered in recent years: 40% of admissions occurred in the last 3 years of the study period (2020–2022) and one quarter occurred in 2022 alone; 4 children had an estimated measles infection during the 2018–2019 outbreak. Because SSPE follows measles after a latency of years, those observations most likely represent the leading edge of a postoutbreak wave; additional cases might emerge over the coming years. For public health, the priority is heightened measles surveillance, early recognition of SSPE in children infected during recent outbreaks, and restoration of high 2-dose vaccination coverage. The short intervals between measles infection and SSPE (2.1–3.5 years) seen in the 4 outbreak-associated cases do not indicate shortening latency: a child infected in 2018 cannot show an interval beyond 4 years in a series closing in 2022, so recent cases are truncated by the observation window. First-dose coverage fell to 64% by 2021, enlarging the susceptible pool beyond the 2018–2019 cohort. A comparable postoutbreak resurgence of SSPE has been reported from the United Kingdom (8). A reported measles history was absent or unknown in a quarter of children; in those children, diagnosis rested on progressive neurodegeneration and presence of measles antibody in CSF or serum. Absence of a reported measles history is often used to argue against SSPE, yet such reasoning would have delayed or missed diagnosis in 5 of those 20 children. Measles antibody testing of CSF is therefore warranted in any child with progressive neurodegeneration and myoclonus, regardless of reported history. Although 85% of children had received a measles-containing vaccine, that does not implicate vaccination: SSPE follows wild-type measles, not the vaccine (1,2). Ten of 19 patients were infected before 9 months, the age of the first scheduled measles-containing vaccine dose in the Philippines (3) and an age group at particularly high risk for SSPE (1,2), and most had received only 1 dose. Those findings support earlier and more complete 2-dose coverage and supplementary immunization during outbreaks. The profile (male predominance, diagnostic delay of weeks to months) was broadly comparable with an earlier Philippines series (6); undernutrition and social disadvantage, noted locally (9), might limit timely vaccination and thereby raise measles and SSPE risk. SSPE cases in the Philippines currently cannot be staged against international criteria because quantitative antibody titers, CSF globulin fractionation, and consistent electroencephalography and neuroimaging are unavailable, a diagnostic-capacity gap worth closing in a country with recurrent measles outbreaks. The first limitation of this study is that, as a single-center retrospective review of 20 patients, it might not represent SSPE nationally, and no population denominator was available, so counts cannot be expressed as rates. Second, measles history, age at infection, and vaccination status were based on guardian recall and could not be verified; the infection-to-SSPE interval is therefore estimated and could not be determined in one quarter of children. Measles antibody was reported only qualitatively, and 3 children were diagnosed using serum antibody without CSF confirmation, although the temporal findings were unchanged when restricted to the 17 with CSF confirmation. Finally, molecular confirmation and genotyping, which require tissue, were not performed, and outcome after discharge was not available. In conclusion, measles antibody testing of CSF should be considered in any child with progressive neurodegeneration and myoclonus, irrespective of the reported measles history. Additional SSPE cases temporally associated with the 2018–2019 outbreak might continue to occur over the remainder of the 2020s. National surveillance for SSPE should be strengthened accordingly. Laboratory capacity should be developed for quantitative measles antibody titration in serum and CSF and for CSF globulin fractionation, so that Philippine cases can be characterized against international diagnostic criteria. Prospective studies capturing outcome and survival in children from the Philippines with SSPE are needed, as is evaluation of supportive and disease-modifying treatment in this population, building on the limited local experience with intravenous immunoglobulin (10). Efforts to restore and sustain 2-dose measles vaccination coverage, including supplementary immunization activities during outbreaks, remain the only means of preventing disease. Where postmortem or biopsy tissue is available, molecular confirmation of measles RNA and genotyping to link cases to circulating strains would strengthen future SSPE surveillance. Volume 32, Number 11—November 2026 Synopsis Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis after Measles Outbreaks, the Philippines, 2007–2022 Suggested citation for this article Abstract Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a delayed, almost uniformly fatal complication of measles. The Philippines had measles outbreaks in 2010–2011, 2013, and 2018–2019; the last was the largest in the World Health Organization Western Pacific Region. Published SSPE data from the Philippines end in 2015. We reviewed all 20 children admitted with SSPE to a tertiary pediatric hospital in Quezon City during 2007–2022 and estimated year of measles infection. Median patient age was 6.2 years at hospital admission and 0.7 years at reported measles illness. Five (25.0%) of 20 admissions occurred in 2022, and estimated infection dates placed 4 patients within the 2018–2019 outbreak; all were admitted during 2020–2022. Given the multiyear latency of SSPE, additional cases might emerge over coming years. Reported measles history could not be established in one quarter of patients. Strengthened measles surveillance and sustained 2-dose vaccination coverage are needed. Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder caused by persistent central nervous system infection with a defective, hypermutant measles virus. It typically follows measles acquired in early childhood after a latency of years and is almost always fatal (1,2). Because SSPE follows measles by years rather than weeks, the neurologic consequences of an outbreak do not become visible until long after the outbreak has ended. Measles vaccination was introduced in the Philippines in 1983; the first routine dose is scheduled at 9 months of age (3). Nationwide immunization campaigns in 1998 and 2004 were followed by historically low measles incidence in 2006 (3). First-dose measles-containing vaccine coverage later declined from 92% in 2004–2007 to 80% in 2015–2016 and 64% in 2021 (4). Reported measles cases rose sharply during a 2018–2019 outbreak, from 2,428 in 2017 to 48,525 in 2019, the largest outbreak in the World Health Organization Western Pacific Region during that period (5). Published data on SSPE in the Philippines are limited; the largest local series described children seen at a single tertiary hospital during 2005–2015 (6). No published series from the Philippines spans the period during which children infected in the 2018–2019 outbreak would be expected to demonstrate symptoms of SSPE. We describe children admitted with SSPE to a tertiary government pediatric hospital over 16 years and examine the distribution of their estimated years of measles infection against the national outbreak record. Design and Setting We retrospectively reviewed the records of all children admitted to National Children’s Hospital, a tertiary government pediatric hospital in Quezon City, the Philippines, with a final diagnosis of SSPE during January 1, 2007–December 31, 2022. All such patients were enumerated. The 2007 start date reflects the period from which complete institutional records and corresponding registry data were available. Case Definition We modified the case definition from Dyken’s criteria (1). We defined a case as a clinical diagnosis of SSPE by the attending pediatric neurologist on the basis of progressive neurologic deterioration with qualitatively positive measles antibody in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), serum, or both. We excluded children with bacterial, tuberculous, or viral meningitis and children with intracranial masses. Because quantitative measles antibody titers, CSF globulin fractionation, brain biopsy, and uniform electroencephalography were unavailable, we could not apply the full Dyken criteria; we classified cases as clinically diagnosed SSPE with varying levels of supportive evidence. Variables Age at reported measles infection and reported measles history came from parental or guardian recall recorded at admission; measles history was recorded as reported, absent, or unknown. Vaccination status was likewise based on parent or guardian report recorded at admission and was not consistently verified against immunization records. Estimation of Year of Reported Measles Infection For each patient, we calculated the interval between measles infection and development of SSPE as age at hospital admission minus age at measles infection. We obtained the estimated calendar year of measles infection by subtracting that interval from the year of admission. We then compared estimated infection years with the recorded periods of national measles outbreak activity. For the 14 children with a parent- or guardian-reported history of measles, we calculated the interval between reported measles illness and hospital admission. We excluded 3 children with a reported measles-to-admission interval of <1 year from the interval analysis, because such a short interval is atypical for SSPE and the timing of the reported measles illness could not be independently verified. A very short interval can also reflect acute measles encephalitis (within 14 days of rash onset) or acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (within weeks), rather than SSPE, which follows a latency of years (1). Statistical Analysis We summarized categorical variables as frequencies and percentages and summarized continuous variables as medians with interquartile ranges. We did not group patients by admission year for comparison, because the multiyear interval between infection and admission makes such grouping uninterpretable. Analyses used Stata 16.1 (StataCorps LLC, https://www.stata.com) and Microsoft Excel (https://www.microsoft.com). The protocol was approved by the National Children’s Hospital Institutional Review Board (approval no. NCH-IRB 2023–12-NCT) using unlinked, deidentified data. Twenty children admitted during January 1, 2007–December 31, 2022, met the case definition. Cases were unevenly distributed across the study period (Figure, panel A). Eight (40.0%) of the 20 admissions occurred in the final 3 years of the series, and 5 (25.0%) admissions occurred in 2022 alone. Four patients had an estimated measles infection year of 2018 or 2019, corresponding to the national outbreak period (Figure, panel B); all 4 had a reported measles history and positive CSF antibody, and all were admitted during 2020–2022 with intervals of 2.1–3.5 years since measles infection. For 3 patients, the estimated infection year was 2004; estimated infection year for 1 patient was 2013. Most patients with an estimable year (14 of 19) were infected outside recognized outbreak periods, consistent with continued transmission between outbreaks. SSPE was suspected at time of admission in 9 (45.0%) patients. The remainder were admitted under other working diagnoses: probable intracranial mass in 4 (20.0%) patients, meningitis in 3 (15.0%) patients, encephalitis in 2 (10.0%) patients, and 1 (5.0%) each of acute rheumatic fever and traumatic brain injury. At discharge, 18 (90.0%) patients carried a diagnosis of SSPE and 2 (10.0%) patients probable SSPE. Of the 20 patients, 14 (70.0%) patients were male and 6 (30.0%) were female. The median age was 6.2 years at admission and 0.7 years at reported measles illness; 10 of the 19 patients with an estimable age were infected before the age of 9 months. Eight children had stunting or wasting, and 3 had comorbidities. A reported measles history was present in 15 (75.0%), unknown in 4 (20.0%), and absent in 1 (5.0%). Seventeen (85.0%) patients had received >1 measles-containing vaccine; 11 (55.0%) patients had received a single dose only. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the association between measles outbreaks and subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) in the Philippines from 2007 to 2022. The authors addressed the knowledge gap regarding the impact of measles outbreaks on SSPE cases, particularly in the context of declining vaccination coverage.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study retrospectively reviewed records of all children admitted to the National Children’s Hospital in Quezon City, Philippines, with a final diagnosis of SSPE from January 1, 2007, to December 31, 2022. The study included 20 patients, with 5 admissions in 2022, and estimated infection dates placed 4 patients within the 2018–2019 outbreak period.
analysis.methods: The study summarized categorical variables as frequencies and percentages and continuous variables as medians with interquartile ranges. Measles antibody testing was performed on cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and serum samples, and electroencephalography (EEG) was conducted in 5 patients.
analysis.main_results: Of the 20 patients, 14 had an estimated measles infection year outside recognized outbreak periods, and 4 had a reported measles history and positive CSF antibody. The median age at reported measles infection was 0.7 years, and at hospital admission, it was 6.2 years. Measles antibody testing was positive in all 17 CSF samples and all 13 serum samples tested.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlighted that a reported measles history was absent or unknown in a quarter of children, emphasizing the importance of CSF antibody testing in diagnosing SSPE. The authors noted that 85% of children had received a measles-containing vaccine, but this does not implicate vaccination in SSPE, as it follows wild-type measles.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that continued measles transmission between outbreaks can lead to SSPE cases, even in vaccinated individuals. The study underscores the need for ongoing surveillance and vaccination efforts to prevent future outbreaks and SSPE cases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-center retrospective design, which may not represent SSPE nationally. Additionally, the absence of a population denominator means that counts cannot be expressed as rates. The study also notes that measles antibody was reported only qualitatively, and 3 children were diagnosed using serum antibody without CSF confirmation, although the temporal findings were unchanged when restricted to the 17 with CSF confirmation.

analysis.summary_en: This study retrospectively reviewed records of children with SSPE in the Philippines from 2007 to 2022, linking measles outbreaks to SSPE cases. It highlighted the importance of CSF antibody testing and the continued transmission of measles between outbreaks, even in vaccinated individuals.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查2007年至2022年菲律宾麻疹(麻疹)暴发(暴发)与亚急性硬化性全脑炎(SSPE)之间的关联。作者解决了关于麻疹(麻疹)暴发(暴发)对SSPE病例影响的知识空白,特别是在疫苗接种(疫苗)覆盖率下降的背景下。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究回顾性审查了2007年1月1日至2022年12月31日期间在奎松市菲律宾国家儿童医院因最终诊断为SSPE入院的所有儿童的记录。研究包括20名患者,其中5名在2022年入院,估计感染日期将4名患者置于2018-2019年暴发(麻疹)期间。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究总结了分类变量的频率和百分比,连续变量的中位数和四分位数范围。对脑脊液(CSF)和血清样本进行了麻疹(麻疹)抗体检测,并对5名患者进行了脑电图(EEG)检查。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在20名患者中,14名患者的麻疹(麻疹)感染年份估计在公认的暴发(麻疹)期间之外,4名患者有报告的麻疹(麻疹)病史和阳性CSF抗体。报告的麻疹(麻疹)感染的中位年龄为0.7岁,入院时为6.2岁。所有17份CSF样本和所有13份血清样本的麻疹(麻疹)抗体检测均为阳性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究强调,四分之一的儿童报告的麻疹(麻疹)病史缺失或未知,突显了CSF抗体检测在诊断SSPE中的重要性。作者指出,85%的儿童接受了麻疹(麻疹)含疫苗(疫苗),但这并不意味着疫苗接种(疫苗)与SSPE有关,因为它是野生型麻疹(麻疹病毒)感染后的结果。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,麻疹(麻疹)传播(疫苗接种)之间的持续传播可能导致SSPE病例,即使是在接种疫苗的人群中。研究强调了持续监测(监测)和疫苗接种(疫苗接种)努力以防止未来暴发(麻疹)和SSPE病例的必要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究受到单中心回顾性设计的限制,可能无法代表全国范围内的SSPE情况。此外,缺乏人口分母意味着无法将计数表示为率。研究还指出,麻疹(麻疹)抗体仅定性报告,3名儿童仅通过血清抗体诊断而未进行CSF确认,尽管当仅限于17名CSF确认的患者时,时间发现没有变化。

papers.title: Epidemiologic shifts predict spatial patterns of measles re-emergence in the United States
papers.abstract: Globally, measles is re-emerging in countries that have previously achieved elimination, including the United States. As immunization rates decline, characterizing the dynamics and evolving spatial pattern of measles re-emergence is critical to inform the public health response. We analyze annual county-level measles cases and vaccine coverage data in the United States (US) from 2011-2025 and find a shift in measles epidemiology in recent years indicative of re-emergence. While outbreak risk is spatially concentrated, we find that outbreaks are increasingly spreading throughout the broader population and across counties, but targeted interventions are predicted to prevent re-emergence nationwide. During the first decade of this period (2011-2020), outbreaks were only weakly associated with county-level vaccine coverage and predominantly isolated to single counties; however, recently (2021-2025), vaccine coverage has become strongly associated with outbreak size and spread across neighboring counties has increased. These findings suggest that measles transmission is increasingly sustained across the broader population rather than only in socially clustered communities. We developed a spatial statistical model to predict outbreak risk and size in all US counties with validation over 2021-2025; the model predicted counties with [≥]10 cases with a sensitivity of 95% (range across 2021-2025: 75-100%) and specificity of 83% (64-98%). Mechanistic models based on county vaccine coverage alone had worse performance, particularly in predicting larger outbreaks. Using the spatial statistical model, we find that prioritizing interventions in the areas of greatest model-predicted risk (e.g., top decile of US counties) was more impactful than state-level interventions (e.g., top five states) or targeting based on low vaccine coverage alone. Achieving even modest (5 percentage point) increases in vaccine coverage in counties in the top decile of model-predicted risk reduced long-term measles risk nationwide by over 90%. Together, these findings demonstrate that predictive risk modeling to inform spatially targeted interventions can likely mitigate the re-emergence of vaccine-preventable diseases.

papers.abstract_zh: 全球范围内,麻疹正在重新出现,包括之前已实现消除的美国。随着疫苗接种率的下降,描述麻疹重新出现的动力学和不断演变的空间模式对于指导公共卫生应对至关重要。我们分析了美国(US)2011年至2025年的年度县一级麻疹病例和疫苗接种覆盖率数据,并发现近年来麻疹的传播模式发生了变化,表明其重新出现。尽管暴发的风险在空间上集中,但我们发现暴发正在逐渐扩散到更广泛的人群和多个县,但有针对性的干预措施预计可以防止全国范围内的重新出现。在这一时期的第一十年(2011-2020年),暴发仅与县一级的疫苗接种覆盖率有较弱关联,并主要局限于单个县;然而,最近(2021-2025年),疫苗接种覆盖率与暴发的规模和向邻近县的扩散显著相关。这些发现表明,麻疹的传播正在逐渐从仅限于社会聚集社区扩展到更广泛的人群。我们开发了一个空间统计模型,用于预测美国所有县的暴发风险和规模,并在2021-2025年期间进行了验证;该模型预测了具有[≥]10例病例的县,其敏感度为95%(2021-2025年期间范围为75-100%),特异度为83%(64-98%)。仅基于县一级疫苗接种覆盖率的机制模型表现较差,尤其是在预测较大的暴发方面。利用该空间统计模型,我们发现,在模型预测风险最高的地区(例如美国县的前10%)优先实施干预措施,其效果比州级干预措施(例如前五大州)或仅基于低疫苗接种覆盖率的干预措施更为显著。在美国模型预测风险最高的县中,即使实现适度(5个百分点)的疫苗接种覆盖率提升,也能将全国范围内的长期麻疹风险降低超过90%。这些发现表明,通过预测性风险建模来指导空间针对性干预措施,可以有效遏制疫苗可预防疾病的重新出现。
